name: An Orphan Looking For a Home

meta.wiki: An Orphan Looking For a Home

summary: After Doling Justice, Kindal Moonweaver greets you on your return from Darnassus with news: a nest full of eggs was saved, though the mother died. Kindal offers you one of the eggs as a pet and sends you on to Quentin, who waits by the race tracks in the Shimmering Flats of Thousand Needles.

sections.title: A Nest Without a Mother
sections.body: Kindal Moonweaver is glad to see you back from Darnassus and reports good progress while you were away. A nest full of eggs was saved, though the mother died before help reached her. The eggs look set to hatch soon, so they will need a good keeper, and Kindal offers you one as a pet. If you are truly interested, carry an egg to the race tracks in the Shimmering Flats, where Quentin will tell you more.

sections.title: Quentin at the Flats
sections.body: Quentin is in Thousand Needles, and asks you not to be fooled by the location: the races are not why Quentin is there. Quentin is investigating how salvageable the land is, hoping to replenish it with new, fertile soil and perhaps find a nearby water source. Quentin also finds the change between Feralas and Thousand Needles odd, and says strange magic was afoot when it happened.

sections.title: What Quentin Makes of the Egg
sections.body: Quentin names it a sprite darter egg, near maturation and in remarkably good condition, and is amazed that you found one. Such creatures are rarely seen in Feralas these days; Quentin has heard that poachers were about, hunting them to capture or kill them, for assorted reasons. Quentin thinks it a shame, for they are beautiful when grown, and asks how you came across such a find.

faq.q: Where did the egg come from?
aliases: where did the egg come from
faq.answer: Kindal Moonweaver and others saved a nest full of eggs while you were in Darnassus. The mother had died before they reached her.
At the race tracks in the Shimmering Flats of Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Why is Quentin at the Shimmering Flats?
aliases: why is quentin at the raceway
faq.answer: Not for the races. Quentin is investigating how salvageable the land is, hoping to bring new, fertile soil to the area and perhaps find a water source nearby.
